SHA  d89172f8... lower_bound is fully unrolled to 12 rounds. Each round does gather(keys, mid) plus addi/shrsi, mid = min((lo+hi)>>1, B-1), cmpf, lo<hi test, andi, lo select, hi=min(mid,hi) select (~11 vector ops). Given the loop invariant 0<=lo<hi<=B and lo+hi<=2B-1, (lo+hi)>>1<=B-1, so the mid clamp is dead; with mid<hi whenever lo<hi, min(mid,hi)=mid, so the hi clamp is dead; after exactly LOG+1 rounds lo==hi and the (lo<hi) guard can never trigger a wrong update, so the guard and one of its two compares are dead work on every round.

SHA 902eca88... segmented inclusive scan is 11 unrolled rounds with two gathers each (previous_target and previous_sum), plus per-round fptosi(previous_target) before an int equality. src_lane = min(keyi & (B-1), ncols-1); keyi&(B-1) is always in [0,B-1] so the min clamp is dead and the gather stays in bounds. previous_target is an exact small integer (<=4096) in fp32, so the per-round fptosi only converts back for comparison and can be replaced by exact fp32 equality. For ncols==B (all hot shapes 1024/2048) there are no sentinel lanes, so the per-lane mask/where on sv and the masked idx/src loads are compile-time unnecessary.

Retained source 72c4d40d is fully qualified: 18/18 formal cases PASSED, geomean speedup 2.094, timing-8 2.4523 (1.4008 ms vs 3.4353 ms). Numerical results (abs_err 2.38e-7, rel_err 1.69e-6 on correctness-8) must be preserved.

Historical identities: 3bd9aac1 failed segment_independence numerics (large_finite/positive_infinity/nan); 4932b8f9 and f41ba9a0 qualified but were not retained (target latency 1.4199 ms / 2.7924 ms). Lesson kept as a constraint: do not alter accumulation order, dtype rounding, or special-value handling; this change only removes provably dead index/guard arithmetic and specializes already-true uniforms.

hypothesis: In the retained sorted-segment path the VECTOR pipeline is the limiting resource (per-program vec time 14.03/9.97 us; observed VECTOR productive 0.907 with MTE lanes idle). A measurable share of that vector issue is provably redundant bookkeeping: two dead clamps and a never-firing loop guard in every one of the 12 lower_bound rounds of sort_out, a dead src_lane clamp in sort_key, a per-round int<->float round-trip in the segmented scan that can be exact fp equality, and mask work on lanes that are all-true when ncols==B. Removing this dead vector work should shorten both kernels proportionally to the removed issue slots without changing any output value.

alternatives: Replace the 11-round segmented scan with global cumsum plus segment-start subtraction (fewer gathers). Rejected: subtracting two large cumulative fp32 sums loses about log2(prefix/segment) bits and can exceed the 1e-4 tolerance; it also changes the established accumulation order.

Fuse sort_key and sort_out into one program. Rejected: profiling MTE2/MTE3 ratios are 0.045/0.022 and 0.059/0.014, the two task durations already sum to the case latency, so there is no memory or launch gap to recover.
Use tl.histogram for run starts instead of lower_bound. Rejected: the same candidate file records histogram at 1.79/8.30 ms for 1024/2048, far above the 0.60 ms sort_out.

Use atomics / inverse permutation to get per-destination sums or starts. Rejected: the file records data-dependent atomic stores at ~4.7 ns/element (MTE3 bound) and a dynamic global store is the pattern already measured ~25x an on-chip gather.

Reduce lower_bound from LOG+1 to LOG rounds. Rejected after checking the worst-case shrink sequence 2048->...->2->1->0: 12 rounds are required for lower_bound with an exclusive hi, so only the dead arithmetic inside each round is removable.
discriminating_observation: If dead vector issue is on the limiting path, then after removing it the per-program aiv_vec_time of _scatter_add_sort_out_kernel should fall by roughly the removed-op fraction (~25-35% of its per-round arithmetic) and _scatter_add_sort_key_kernel by a smaller amount, task durations should move the same direction, and MTE2/MTE3 ratios should stay <=0.06. If instead gather latency or MTE dominates, vec time and task durations should be unchanged while only instruction counts fall.
